result.brief: 提出角色感知的4D世界-动作模型，用目标SE(3)轨迹与稀疏3D流替代视频预测，并给出考虑策略延迟的动态操作基准OnTimeBench。
result.reason: Role-aware 4D world-action model with compact SE(3) trajectory and sparse 3D flow representation for dynamic manipulation; main contribution is embodied world modeling and policy, not general video representation.
